title: 第25章 师兄的指点第26章 武者的特权

“像我师父，还有你母亲，都只属于师祖的内门弟子。”董鑫道。
亲传弟子？内门弟子？方羽默默记下。
因为母亲缘故，在父亲指引下，他了解过大焚天时代前的古武传承，那个时代，门徒弟子一般分为记名弟子、内门弟子、亲传弟子。
记名弟子，往往只挂个名，甚至不一定亲自指点。
内门弟子，通常要正常授课，有明确拜师环节，三节两寿是不可缺少的，弟子出错师父也要担一定责。
而亲传弟子，则是真正的‘传承弟子’，师徒常年生活在一起、日夜授徒，为徒弟摸骨正形、寻找修炼草药、为弟子准备成亲所需等，和‘亲子’基本无异，好处和责任也是对等的，若师父年老体衰，仇人上门，也要亲传弟子一力接下。
正因亲传弟子如此重要，师父付出代价大，所以，一位武师，一辈子大多只能收两三位亲传弟子，至多四五位。
天资、秉性、家世等，都在考察范围内。
星空武道时代，整个文明都是大范围传授武道，不再像古代那般严苛，可内门弟子、亲传弟子的名号，依旧难得。
“论实力，江威师叔应该也已达到39级，且技艺极高，应该是内景大成层次。”
“像我这种31级高级武者，在高级武者中属于很稚嫩的，面对江威师叔，估计会被一招秒杀。”董师兄笑呵呵道：“江威师叔还不到60岁，有望成大地武者。”
方羽听后愈惊。
内景大成？这种武道技艺，的确是很恐怖，许多高级武者技艺连入微大成都没到……同为高级武者，实力的确天差地别。
“师祖门徒众多。”
“传到我们这第三代，其实早已星散各处，有去新月的，有去其他行省乃至其他国度的。”董鑫道：“所以，彼此间交集并不多。”
方羽不由点头。
就如亲戚间，一代亲二代表……师门传承同样如此，尤其这个时代，徒弟和师父没有人身依附关系。
越往后，自然越疏远。
像自己和董师兄关系亲近，也是因为母亲白青和师伯庞鸿关系好，又都住在武陵市……所以两人从小熟到大。

“不过。”
“师弟你现在重新踏入武者圈，随你实力越来越强，未来成高级武者，那些师叔师伯、同辈的师兄弟姐妹，自然都会联系你。”董鑫笑道：“像我，提前毕业这两年，联系我的同门就有好几十位。”
“你强大，这些关系才是关系。”
方羽不由点头。
像此前，董师兄不会和自己提及师门的事……不是董师兄不关心自己，而是提了也没用。
实力不够强，强行去攀关系，也没意义。
自身，才是根本。
“小龙和思月，同时觉醒上位星相的事，一门双上位，我也有所耳闻，在武陵市的武道圈子，可是引起了不小的震动。”董鑫笑道：“实际上，你的技艺天赋，我感觉比上位星相还要夸张，你们这一支，注定是要崛起。”
“要不了多久，说不定师祖都会知晓。”董鑫感慨。
“师祖？”方羽一惊。
师祖裴凡。
在大地武者中都属强者了啊。
“我的技艺天赋，有这么强？”方羽略有些迟疑。
“上位星相，吸收星力效率极高，能轻松成高级武者，哪怕技艺天赋差，稍微提供些药剂宝物，30岁左右，也都能成39级武者了。”董鑫反而谈起了上位星相：“这是我所不能及的，像我估计，得再修炼10年才能成39级。”
“还要10年？”方羽吃惊。
董师兄，现在就已是31级。
“武道等级划分，每10级是个大槛。”董鑫笑道：“像你这一个多月，从15级到20级，拳力提升了近一千公斤吧。”

"My master and your mother are only inner disciples of our master," Dong Xin said.
Personal disciple? Inner disciple? Fang Yu silently wrote it down.
Because of his mother, and under the guidance of his father, he learned about the ancient martial arts inheritance before the Great Fentian era. In that era, disciples were generally divided into registered disciples, inner disciples, and direct disciples.
Named disciples often only have a name, and may not even give guidance in person.
Inner disciples usually have to teach normally, and there is a clear link of apprenticeship. Three periods and two lives are indispensable. The master must also bear some responsibility for the disciple's mistakes.
The direct disciples are the real "inherited disciples". The master and the apprentice live together all year round, teach the disciples day and night, touch the disciple's bones, find herbs for cultivation, and prepare the disciples' necessities for marriage, etc. They are basically the same as "parents and children", and the benefits and responsibilities are equal. If the master is old and frail, and the enemy comes, the direct disciples must take over.
Because direct disciples are so important and the master pays a high price, a martial artist can only have two or three direct disciples in his lifetime, or at most four or five.
Talent, temperament, family background, etc. are all within the scope of inspection.
In the era of Starry Sky Martial Arts, the entire civilization taught martial arts on a large scale. It was no longer as strict as in ancient times, but the titles of inner disciples and direct disciples were still rare.
"In terms of strength, Uncle Jiang Wei should have reached level 39, and his skills are extremely high. He should be at the level of the Master of Internal Scenery."
"A level 31 senior warrior like me is very immature among senior warriors. Facing Master Uncle Jiang Wei, I will probably be killed with one move." Senior Brother Dong said with a smile: "Master Uncle Jiang Wei is not yet 60 years old, and he is expected to become an earth warrior."
Fang Yu became even more shocked after hearing this.
Interior scene completed? This kind of martial arts skills is indeed terrifying. Many high-level warriors have not even reached the level of mastery... They are both high-level warriors, but their strength is indeed very different.
"The master has many disciples."
"By the time it reaches our third generation, they have actually dispersed in various places. Some have gone to New Moon, some to other provinces and even other countries." Dong Xin said: "So, there are not many interactions with each other."
Fang Yu couldn't help but nod.
Just like between relatives, one generation represents the second generation... The same is true for the inheritance of the master, especially in this era, the apprentice and the master have no personal attachment relationship.
The farther back you go, the more distant you become.
For example, I have a close relationship with Senior Brother Dong because my mother Bai Qing has a good relationship with my senior uncle Pang Hong, and they both live in Wuling City... so the two have known each other since childhood.
"But."
"Junior brother, you are now re-entering the martial arts circle. As your strength becomes stronger and stronger, and you become a high-level warrior in the future, those uncles, uncles, brothers and sisters of the same generation will naturally contact you." Dong Xin said with a smile: "Like me, I graduated two years early, and I have dozens of classmates who have contacted me."
"You are strong, and these relationships are relationships."
Fang Yu couldn't help but nod.
Like before, Senior Brother Dong would not mention his master's affairs to him... It wasn't that Senior Brother Dong didn't care about him, but it was useless to mention it.
If you are not strong enough, there is no point in trying to force a relationship.
The self is the foundation.
"I have also heard that Xiaolong and Siyue awakened to the upper astrology at the same time. They both ascended to the upper level. It caused quite a shock in the martial arts circle in Wuling City." Dong Xin said with a smile: "Actually, I feel that your technical talent is even more exaggerated than that of the upper astrology. Your branch is destined to rise."
"It won't take long, maybe Master will know about it." Dong Xin sighed.
"Master?" Fang Yu was surprised.
Master Pei Fan.
They are all strong among the earth warriors.
"How talented is my skill?" Fang Yu hesitated a little.
"Upper-level astrology absorbs star power very efficiently, and can easily become a high-level warrior. Even if you have poor skills and talent, you can become a level 39 warrior at around 30 years old if you provide some potions and treasures." Dong Xin instead talked about upper-level astrology: "This is beyond my ability.Yes, as I estimate, it will take another 10 years of practice to reach level 39. "
"10 more years? "Fang Yu was surprised.
Senior Brother Dong is already level 31 now.
“The level of martial arts is divided into 10 levels, which is a big threshold. Dong Xin smiled and said: "In more than a month like yours, from level 15 to level 20, your boxing power has increased by nearly a thousand kilograms." "
